description.value: The study examined limbic brain responses to unseen backward-masked cocaine, sexual, aversive, and neutral cues in male cocaine patients and tested whether the cocaine-cue response predicted later affective bias to visible cocaine cues.

spans.text: We demonstrate, for the first time, limbic brain activation by “unseen” drug and sexual cues of only 33 msec duration.
